listing.name: Jersey Devil — Jersey Devil Recompiled (mstan)
listing.summary: Prepare your own USA Jersey Devil disc with the publisher’s Windows x64 player (v0.3.3) or Linux x86-64 AppImage (v0.3.2). Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SCUS94907 disc with all 45 tracks and boot executable SCUS_949.07.

steps.title: Choose the upstream package
steps.instruction: On Windows x64, extract the v0.3.3 ZIP. On Linux x86-64, use the v0.3.2 AppImage and check its setup instructions. Start the upstream player and choose the CUE file for your complete disc set. Keep your original disc files separately.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, intros, levels and gameplay. This is a new project; Portcove has not confirmed those results.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
